description: Read public stats for TikTok video or photo posts by URL or post ID. Returns one flat row per post with plays, likes, comments, shares, saves, caption, hashtags, post date, sound, and the author's follower and like totals. Costs 0.0004 USD per post read, 0.0004 USD per post TikTok reports as deleted, private, or missing, plus 0.006 USD per run start. Bot check pages are free rows.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Summary rows are always returned.

max_videos.description: The most posts to read in this run, from 1 to 1,000. Default 100. Text or a number.

videos.description: TikTok video or photo post URLs (https://www.tiktok.com/@handle/video/ID) or numeric post IDs, up to 1,000 per run. Duplicates are read once.

name: get_tiktok_video_stats
title: Get TikTok video stats
